sources.name: U.S. electric substations
sources.custodian: ORNL, LANL, INL, NGA / HSIP; ArcGIS publisher ja22_sk9655
sources.description: Published substation and tap locations. Loaded by map area with source attributes; connectivity and telemetry are not supplied.

sources.name: U.S. electric power transmission lines
sources.custodian: U.S. Government / Esri Federal User Community
sources.description: Archived public transmission-line geography. The publisher marks this layer as no longer maintained. Published endpoints and voltages do not establish explicit topology or current energization.
sources.attribution: U.S. Government / Esri Federal User Community

sources.name: U.S. natural gas interstate / intrastate pipelines
sources.custodian: U.S. Energy Information Administration; ORNL Open Energy Hub
sources.description: Published natural gas pipeline geometry, operators, and pipeline types. Uses supported 100-record pages or area-filtered GeoJSON exports rather than the unsupported limit=20000 request.
sources.attribution: U.S. EIA via ORNL Open Energy Hub

sources.name: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles
sources.description: Photorealistic geographic context. Requires a referrer-restricted Map Tiles API key.

sources.name: OpenFreeMap
sources.description: 2D basemap used when 3D is unconfigured or unavailable.

sources.name: USGS 3DEP elevation
sources.description: Elevation and terrain context. An elevation adapter is a future milestone.

sources.name: National Weather Service
sources.description: Weather observations, forecasts, and alerts. Catalog only in this version.

sources.name: FEMA flood hazards
sources.description: National Flood Hazard Layer. A hazard overlay adapter is a future milestone.

sources.name: Census TIGERweb
sources.description: Administrative and statistical boundaries. Catalog only in this version.

sources.name: Utility GIS
sources.description: Authoritative asset inventory and explicit network connectivity.

sources.name: AMI / meter data
sources.description: Meter interval readings. Observation CSV imports are available; live integration is not configured.

sources.name: SCADA / operational telemetry
sources.description: Read-only telemetry is a future adapter. No equipment control is implemented.

sources.name: Outage management
sources.description: Outage events and asset associations. Live OMS integration is a future adapter.

sources.name: Enterprise asset management
sources.description: Asset records, maintenance, and regulatory metadata.

sources.name: Predictive and simulation results
sources.description: Future engineering-study and predictive result datasets.
